item.text:
“the stakes for our movement has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our movement have never been higher”

“the federal goverment” >>> “the federal government”

“matters more then ever” >>> “matters more than ever”

“has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named]

“but it's definitions are broad” >>> “but its definitions are broad”

“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”

“the bill's enforcment regime” >>> “the bill's enforcement regime”

“directly effect every company” >>> “directly affect every company”

“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield is identified earlier as R-OH]

“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: the registry is assigned to Section 4 earlier]

“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: the earlier summary says the civil penalty is $1 million per day]

“Senator Grant, who's support” >>> “Senator Grant, whose support”

“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”

“Senator Gallager” >>> [CHECK: verify the spelling of the senator’s surname]

“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee’s 28 members”

“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: these figures total 29, not 28]

“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow” >>> [CHECK: only five senators are listed, although the preceding sentence says six are undecided]

“the markup on Thursday, October 14” >>> “the markup on Thursday, October 15”

“after the September 23 hearing” >>> [CHECK: the timeline says the committee hearing occurred on September 30]

“in a seperate interview” >>> “in a separate interview”

“Senator Ames said he has not made a final decision either” >>> [CHECK: Ames—and possibly Kowalski—appears undecided but is omitted from the stated list of undecided senators]

“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached”

“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”

“the week November 16” >>> “the week of November 16”

“occured on September 30” >>> “occurred on September 30”

“would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: the Section 6 summary says the deadline is 18 months]

“is a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “is a close complement to S. 2817”

“Our six field organizers” >>> [CHECK: the memo later says there are five field organizers]

“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”

“call there senators” >>> “call their senators”

“should recieve updated talking points” >>> “should receive updated talking points”
